items.exampleEn: Bright lights repel some insects but attract others.
items.exampleZh: 明亮的燈光會趕走某些昆蟲，卻會吸引另一些昆蟲。

items.exampleEn: Hot water gushes from the rocks at this famous spring.
items.exampleZh: 熱水從這處著名溫泉的岩石間湧出。

items.exampleEn: The chef tinkered with the recipe until it was just right.
items.exampleZh: 主廚反覆調整食譜，直到味道剛剛好。

items.exampleEn: Noise from the adjoining office made it hard to concentrate.
items.exampleZh: 隔壁辦公室傳來的噪音讓人很難專心。

items.exampleEn: We gave away old clothes to reduce the clutter in our cupboards.
items.exampleZh: 我們把舊衣服送人，減少櫃子裡的雜物。

items.exampleEn: The goalkeeper pounced on the loose ball.
items.exampleZh: 守門員撲向那顆沒人控制的球。

items.exampleEn: Birds congregate around the lake in early spring.
items.exampleZh: 初春時，鳥群會聚集在湖的周圍。

items.exampleEn: The dog gnawed happily on an old bone.
items.exampleZh: 那隻狗開心地啃著一根舊骨頭。

items.sentenceEn: Every critic gushed over the young actor's first film.
items.sentenceZh: 每位影評人都對這位年輕演員的第一部電影讚不絕口。

items.audioEn: Fans began to congregate outside the hotel hours before the singer arrived.
items.audioZh: 歌手抵達前好幾個小時，歌迷就開始聚集在飯店外。
items.questionZh: 歌迷在歌手抵達之前做了什麼？
options: They waited at the airport with signs

items.sentenceEn: Please stop tinkering with the settings; the printer works fine.
items.sentenceZh: 請不要再亂動設定了，印表機好好的。

items.sentenceEn: This jacket has a special layer that repels water.
items.sentenceZh: 這件外套有一層特殊的防水層，可以把水擋開。

items.stemEn: We booked two ____ rooms so the children could sleep right next to us.
items.stemZh: 我們訂了兩間相連的房間，這樣孩子們就能睡在我們隔壁。

items.stemEn: The salesman ____ on the first customer who walked through the door.
items.stemZh: 第一位客人一走進門，那位業務員就立刻撲上去招呼。

items.passageEn: My grandfather spends most weekends tinkering with old radios in his garage. The place is full of clutter: boxes of wires, battered tools and newspapers he refuses to discard. Last winter, a mouse moved in and started to gnaw through the wires. Grandpa tried a spray that was supposed to repel mice, but it did not work. In the end, our cat solved the problem. She hid behind a box for an hour and then pounced. A week later, a pipe burst and sent water gushing across the floor. Neighbors congregated in the adjoining yard to watch Grandpa and my father carry everything outside.
items.passageZh: 我爺爺大部分的週末都在車庫裡擺弄舊收音機。那裡堆滿了雜物：一箱箱電線、破舊的工具，還有他不肯丟掉的報紙。去年冬天，一隻老鼠住了進來，開始啃咬電線。爺爺試了一種據說能驅鼠的噴劑，但沒有用。最後是我們家的貓解決了問題：牠躲在箱子後面一個小時，然後猛撲上去。一星期後，一根水管破裂，水湧得滿地都是。鄰居們聚集在隔壁的院子裡，看著爺爺和我爸爸把所有東西搬到外面。

questions.questionZh: 最後是誰解決了老鼠的問題？
水管破掉之後發生了什麼事？
options: 爺爺把車庫的門鎖起來
鄰居聚在隔壁院子看他們搬東西

items.promptZh: 我的書桌上堆滿了文件，我什麼都找不到。
referenceEn: My desk is cluttered with papers, and I can't find anything.
Papers clutter my desk, so I can't find anything.
rubricZh: 「堆滿」用 clutter，例如 be cluttered with＋東西，或讓東西當主詞（Papers clutter my desk）
「什麼都找不到」可寫，例如 can't find anything 等

items.promptZh: 每天傍晚，附近的居民都會聚集在廟前下棋。
referenceEn: Every evening, people from the neighborhood congregate in front of the temple to play chess.
Local residents congregate outside the temple every evening to play chess.
rubricZh: 「聚集」用 congregate（例如 congregate in front of the temple 等）
「附近的居民」可寫，例如 people from the neighborhood、local residents 等
說的是習慣，時態配合內容
